'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Tumbler Ridge shooting]]
**Nine people are killed, including the suspect, in a [[school shooting]] at [[Tumbler Ridge Secondary School]] in [[Tumbler Ridge]], [[British Columbia]], Canada. [https://www.cbc.ca/lite/story/9.7083740 (CBC News)] [https://www.jpost.com/international/article-886269 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

**The [[Malaysia]]n [[Federal Court of Malaysia|federal court]] reinstates the [[bribery]] conviction and six-year [[Sungai Buloh Prison|prison]] sentence of former [[Federal Land Development Authority]] chairperson [[Mohd Isa Abdul Samad]] after overturning a 2024 acquittal on nine corruption counts linked to a hotel purchase.
